sanskrit_verse:
ṛṇisvahastasaṃdehe jīvato vā mṛtasya vā /
tatsvahastakṛtair anyaiḥ patrais tallekhyaniṛṇayaḥ // BrhS_1,6.54
transliteration: ṛṇisvahastasaṃdehe jīvato vā mṛtasya vā / tatsvahastakṛtair anyaiḥ patrais tallekhyaniṛṇayaḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: In the matter of debt or obligation arising from personal assurance, whether the debtor is alive or deceased, the liability shall be discharged through documents or instruments executed by others bearing the signature or seal of the original obligor.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in the continuity of conscious commitment, not physical presence
Causation flows through documented intent authenticated by recognized symbols of identity
Capacity-based responsibility extends beyond mortality through authorized representation
Restoration logic requires fulfillment of energetic completion regardless of bodily state
Consciousness alignment occurs when obligation is resolved through verified indicia of will
executable_legal_axioms: IF debtor_status = 'alive' OR 'deceased' AND valid_signature_on_file = TRUE THEN obligation_transferable = TRUE
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicates based on verification of authentic indicia linking third-party execution to original obligor's conscious intent. Mortality does not sever dharma-vyavahara; authority continues through verified symbolic extension.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that obligation persists through authenticated signs of continued will. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation of intent through lawful instruments. Responsibility aligns proportionally with documented capacity. Non-punitive reality rule affirms resolution through completion rather than penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Verification protocol for symbolic authentication of continuing obligation
Documentary completion process ensuring alignment of third-party action with original intent
Capacity restoration via certified representation mechanisms
Integrity reintegration through public record confirmation of fulfilled duty
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands established: Obligation transcends mortality through verified expression of will. Justice restores balance without inflicting pain. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator.
